veranderings.rede: For a sound that lasts, Afrikaans says 'lank aanhou'; 'lank hou' reads as 'keep for long'.

veranderings.voor: Die fluit is meestal van metaal en tog houtblaas.
veranderings.na: Die fluit is meestal van metaal, en tog is dit houtblaas.
veranderings.rede: The clipped second half lacks a verb; giving it subject and verb reads more naturally, with the AWS comma before 'en'.

veranderings.voor: al klink dit ewe hoog en hard
veranderings.na: al klink dit ewe hoog en hard as 'n ander instrument
veranderings.rede: Read alone, 'ewe hoog en hard' has nothing to compare with; naming the other instrument makes the comparison clear without changing the meaning.
'Binne' as a bare ending is clipped; 'daarin' is the natural Afrikaans form.
'Sywaarts' is the usual Afrikaans word for this movement direction and sits better beside 'vorentoe' and 'agtertoe'.
